pages.text: Bind the Soul Engine item with a supported filled Soul Vial. The stock Soul Binder job costs 188,000 FE and five levels’ worth of XP Juice. Place the bound engine, install a capacitor and pipe in the matching fuel.

A Blaze-bound engine uses lava. Zombie, Zombie Villager and Husk use Nutrient Distillation. A Creeper uses Rocket Fuel and an Enderman uses Dew of the Void. The active binding and fuel appear in the engine menu.

Set an output face to Push or connect an energy conduit. Feed a $(l:enderio:power/banks)Capacitor Bank$(/l) to store the output. The $(l:enderio:machines/advanced_fluids)fuel recipes$(/l) explain how to make Rocket Fuel and other liquids.
A Farming Station also has a binding recipe. Use its item and a supported soul such as a Bee, Villager or Sniffer. A Phantom can instead bind a photovoltaic module for night generation.
